transcript.content: Hello. I'm a board-certified psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for the last five months. I just feel completely empty inside, and nothing seems to help. It's been really hard to keep going like this.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the opposite—extremely energized, on top of the world, or needing very little sleep?
No, I've never felt like that. I've mostly just felt really drained and exhausted, never high energy or on top of the world. It's been the complete opposite for me.
Did these feelings of depression start after a specific stressful event, loss, or major change in your life?

I can't really recall any specific stressful event, loss, or major life change that triggered this. It just seemed to start on its own about five months ago, and I've been feeling this way ever since.
During these past five months, have you heard or seen things that other people couldn't, or held any strong beliefs that others felt weren't true?

Yes, I have. Over the last few months, I've been hearing voices whispering to me when no one else is around, and it's terrifying. I also can't shake the feeling that people are watching me and plotting to harm me, even though others tell me it's not happening.
Have you ever experienced these voices or the feeling of being watched during times when you were not feeling depressed or sad?

Yes, I have. There were times, for at least a couple of weeks, when my mood felt relatively normal but I was still hearing those whispering voices and feeling like I was being watched. It seems like those scary experiences can happen even when I'm not feeling down or empty.
Did these voices and feelings of being watched start around the same five-month period as your depression, or have you been dealing with them for a much longer time?

Actually, the voices and the feeling of being watched have been going on for much longer, for about eleven months in total. The deep sadness and empty feelings only started later, about five months ago. So I was dealing with those scary experiences for several months before the depression even set in.
Apart from the voices and feeling watched, have you noticed a significant loss of motivation, social withdrawal, or difficulty expressing your emotions during this 11-month period?

Yes, I have definitely noticed those things, especially over the last month or so. I've had almost no motivation to do anything, I find myself pulling away from family and friends, and it's been really hard to show or express any emotion at all. It feels like I'm just completely shut down.

During the entire 11 months that you've experienced the voices and paranoia, would you say you have felt depressed for most of that total time, or has the depression been limited to just these last 5 months?

Yes, the depression itself has been going on for these last five months. However, I would say it has been present for the majority of the time that my struggles have been at their most active and difficult over this eleven-month period.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has experienced both psychotic symptoms (hallucinations and persecutory delusions) and a major depressive episode. The psychotic symptoms have been present for 11 months, including a 6-month period before the onset of depression where mood was normal, which rules out Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features. The depressive episode has lasted for 5 months, representing a substantial portion of the total 11-month duration of the illness, which supports Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type) over Schizophrenia.
